srList.sentence: Chemical composition ( DM basis ) of the ramie was: crude protein 173 g/kg , neutral detergent fiber 621 g/kg , acid detergent fiber 449 g/kg , Ca 36.2 g/kg , P 2.75 g/kg , and ash 138 g/kg ( Tang et al. , 2019) . 2.2 Animals and experimental design Thirty-two male Liuyang Black goats ( 6 to 8 months of age ) were treated for parasites with 0.2 mg/kg ivermectin , 10 mg/kg albendazole , and 20 mg/kg praziquantel and allowed to adapt to the environment over a 2 wk period.
